claims.statement: Under explicit base assumptions, one million admitted nodes expose approximately the modeled resources recorded in the results artifact.
A physical BIZRA network achieves the emulated scale or outperforms centralized systems on selected workloads.

limitations: H100-equivalent values are modeling units, not measured conversions for real BIZRA hardware.
PAT identities are local roles and are not counted as shared URP workers by default.
Five SAT identities per node do not equal five independent origins; independent origins are bounded by node count.
No real BIZRA telemetry was available; all node contribution parameters are replaceable assumptions.
The centralized anchor is a vendor-published upper-scale architecture, not an independently reproduced benchmark.
